title: Inequality and unpredictability in an artificial cultural market (Salganik, Dodds and Watts 2006)
description:
Sociology: The design carries the weight. The study records what a reader of an experiment with people asks first: the conditions, who was assigned to them, and how many took part. A worked example for Discourse Graphs, read from the paper by hand. The paper's own text and figures are not included.

An RO-Crate: open README.md or ro-crate-preview.html inside the archive to read it. Every finding is also described in the MIRA schema.
